verdict.rationale: LangGraph is an open-source pip package with self-hostable persistence (PostgresSaver) and a CLI to run the Agent Server locally, showing no hard vendor lock-in for core execution. However, evidence around production-grade deployment is thin—community members explicitly ask how to deploy LangGraph as a production API beyond local 'langgraph serve', and LangSmith/vendor tooling is referenced for debugging, leaving self-hosted production readiness only partially substantiated.
